WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
           AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_iga_minus_igm
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
with_ratios AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, avg_pt, avg_iga_minus_igm,
           avg_iga_minus_igm / NULLIF(AVG(avg_iga_minus_igm) OVER (), 0) AS ratio
    FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT SEX,
       AVG(avg_pt) AS average_patient_avg_pt,
       AVG(avg_iga_minus_igm) AS average_patient_avg_iga_minus_igm,
       AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio
FROM with_ratios
WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL AND SEX <> ''
GROUP BY SEX;
